identity.name: CareHome Clocking
identity.mission: Simplify attendance for busy care workers with zero friction.

headings.usage: Page titles, Kiosk instructions, Modal headers

data.usage: PIN codes, Time displays, Employee IDs, QR codes

primary.description: Royal Blue - Trustworthy, standard for medical/admin.

accent.description: Vivid Yellow - High visibility for Kiosk Dark Mode.

contrast_rules.kiosk: Must meet AAA contrast. Use Black/White or Navy/Yellow.
contrast_rules.dashboard: Standard AA compliance. Subtle borders for separation.

kiosk.name: The ATM Interface
kiosk.spacing: Massive padding (p-8 to p-16). Touch targets min 64px height.
kiosk.container: max-w-2xl mx-auto h-full flex flex-col justify-center

mobile_app.name: The Authenticator Flow
mobile_app.structure: Stack Navigation. Full-screen QR. Large PIN display.

buttons.kiosk: h-20 text-2xl rounded-xl w-full shadow-none border-2

inputs.kiosk: h-20 text-3xl text-center tracking-widest border-2 rounded-xl

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg (0.5rem) for dashboard, rounded-xl (0.75rem) for kiosk
visual_enhancers.shadows: None by default. Use borders for definition.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise for Kiosk background to reduce glare.

animations.kiosk: Instant feedback. No slow fades. Snap transitions.

accessibility.screen_reader: All inputs must have aria-labels. Status changes must be announced.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text.
For the Kiosk UI, prioritize SIZE and CONTRAST over beauty. It must be usable by a 60-year-old with glasses.
The Kiosk should have a 'High Contrast' toggle that switches to Black BG + Yellow Text.
Do not use gradients for the dashboard. Keep it flat and clean.
For the Mobile App (React Native), use native-feeling components but match the brand colors.
Ensure the 'Offline Mode' indicator is prominent on the Kiosk (e.g., a red banner or icon).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY for overlays, not main content.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
